titleSq: Banesë në shitje në Fushë Kosovë
titleEn: Apartment for sale in Fushë Kosovë
landmarkEn: near the former Active Home, now Eli-Ab
descriptionSq: Ofrohet për shitje banesë me sipërfaqe prej 95.58m², e vendosur në Rrugën Dardania, pranë ish-Active Home, tani Eli-Ab, vetëm rreth 2 minuta larg pompës Kastrati.
Banesa është ndërtim nga Britania Homes, ndodhet në katin e 7-të dhe objekti ka dy lifta funksionalë. Ka orientim nga Lindja dhe është komplet e mobiluar me stil modern.

Organizimi i banesës përbëhet nga qëndrimi ditor me kuzhinë, dy dhoma gjumi, një banjo, depo dhe ballkon.
Prona posedon ngrohje elektrike nën dysheme dhe klimë.
Banesa ka fletë poseduese, ndërsa kontrata e shitblerjes realizohet te noteri.
descriptionEn: Offered for sale: an apartment with an area of 95.58m², located on Rruga Dardania, near the former Active Home, now Eli-Ab, only about 2 minutes from the Kastrati petrol station.
The apartment was built by Britania Homes, is located on the 7th floor and the building has two functioning elevators. It faces East and is fully furnished in a modern style.

The layout of the apartment consists of a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom, a storage room and a balcony.
The property has electric underfloor heating and air conditioning.
The apartment has an ownership certificate, while the sale contract is signed at the notary.
Price: Contact us for the price.
